declarations.rationale: Tell8/ask7/notify5 dominate addressed communication; work-with and opposition remain separate.
Head/headed11 and director6 plus other formal-office paths are a genuinely mixed office family; founder/professor/editor alone are distinct.
Write-in6 plus explicit writing/reviewing and reviewer-for paths dominate authorship for publications; say-in9 is ambiguous quotation versus authorship and must not automatically pass.
Subsidiary/unit/company-parent paths dominate29+ of34, child-to-parent direction; certificate-filing unrelated.
Source legislature and target party roles inspected; controlled-by9 and hold/have subject paths form the inverse control family. Individual leaders/majority modifiers alone not control.
Die-in12 plus death-in4/perish and fatal accident dominate; residence/rescue/escape and killing others do not establish source death.
Lawyer-for/with/at and attorney-for26/33 dominate legal affiliation; coordinator/specialist/representative alone do not substitute.
Leader title/amod/nn14 plus whip and former leader dominates; fund-raiser and ordinary presence remain distinct.

Include8 and group/team source-to-person roles establish the inverse membership family; lead-by and geographic region-to-state are competing meanings. Actual member versus geographic part remains distinct.
Champion/title/retain/hold/defend dominates; medalist without championship, title challenge or stage victory alone not sufficient.
Explicit chairperson title/tenure dominates despite seven nominate-as paths; choose office rather than nomination so candidacy-only facts remain outside scope.
Visit/trip/to5+4+4 and make-visit1 dominate; campaign and proposed/rejected travel remain separate or ambiguous.
Owner/own/ownership15 plus explicit purchase/co-owner dominate; leadership or bare games do not assert ownership.
Executive title pathways P0/P3/P5/P6/P9/P10 dominate15/30 and exceed any specific competing title; chief/chair/mogul alone do not broaden the fixed role.
Join/entry/accession paths dominate with organizational targets inspected; join-with action or geographic gateway remains outside membership.
Withdraw/withdrawal/pullout13 rows is the dominant directional family; capture/invasion and geographical operation do not by themselves prove withdrawal.
Explicit director-of/tenure paths dominate; generic official is the main competing title.
Urge6 is the largest individually coherent family; hold/take, political control, influence, ownership and accusation remain competing meanings. Broad association rejected.
Replace10/succeed2 plus replacement/take-place paths dominate person-to-predecessor direction. Replacing someone by appointing a third person does not establish personal succession.
Control/take-control/win/retain/regain form dominant explicit political control of legislature; committee membership alone does not qualify.
Go-to15 plus dispatch-to is dominant movement family; founded, athletic events and institution membership are distinct.
Explicit owner noun-modifier/possessive/of and historical ownership dominate; partner or operational control alone is not substituted.
Economist title pathways13 exceed analyst6 and other financial/academic roles; preserve economist-specific rather than union-of-employment meaning.
